descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S01 「医院，在 app 里走 UAT 第 1–3 步：查房前任务，Save & Extract 关掉两个，第三个保持未完成，有条件的任务，没有撤回的任务」 Hospital, UAT steps 1–3 in the app: pre-round tasks, Save & Extract closes two, third open, conditional task, no retraction task

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Tasks dictated in pre-round ('follow up BMP', 'PT eval', 'recheck weight in two weeks') appear on the patient's task list as three open tasks, one each (the precondition the Expected Result's 'the th …（UAT TC-22 step 1；TFA-92588 AC 10） — gate: blocked: TFA-92588 ready for pr
  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). …（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U3 No duplicates: closing a task adds no new task for the same item, and Save & Extract never adds a task that is already on the list, open or closed（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U4 The task whose result is not dictated ('recheck weight in two weeks') stays open（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U5 A conditional order ('advance diet to clears if pain stays under 4') becomes a task（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U6 A retraction ('leave glargine at 20') does not become a task（UAT TC-22；TFA-92592 AC 3） — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • T2 Tasks closed by dictation show as completed, with the visit they were closed on（TFA-92585 AC 8） — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U12 Each run records which AI ran each step: the model for task extraction (parsing.extractTasks) and for the Hospital pre-round processing, and whether the backup model was used（UAT 3.9；UAT 3.1）

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given Fresh @roundai.test physician with one Hospital patient (make-session fixture); no tasks

When Type the three UAT tasks into the pre-round notes and Save Note; then type the UAT bedside dictation into the encounter notes and tap Save & Extract; open Post-Round → Tasks and Task Export

Then After Save Note: three open tasks (BMP, PT, weight). After Save & Extract: BMP and PT completed, weight still open, one new open task to advance the diet to clears if pain stays under 4, no glargine/insulin task, nothing listed twice; Task Export shows weight pending and BMP and PT under Finished Tasks, each finished row with the visit/day it was closed on

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT TC-22 Expected Result. Header '3 pending tasks' then '2 pending tasks' plus regex checks on the 'Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' button names (the pre-round tasks are worded by the model, so fixed strings cannot decide them): 2 pending = weight + the conditional task, which must name the diet/clears, the pain condition and the 4 in either word order (Q6); …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S01 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-22.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：AICHECK · AI 输出检查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
